title: Course 1 Review & Microcontroller Master Challenge
summary: You have completed your comprehensive tour of the microcontroller universe! Put on your detective hat and prove your skills in the Grand Capstone Exam.

steps.title: Course 1 Master Recap
steps.markdownContent: You have explored boards, signals, circuits, code, and safety. Now use those ideas to help a robot choose a board and respond to an input.

quickCheck.question: What is the main role of a microcontroller development board in robotics?
options: To act as the brain reading sensors and controlling outputs
To serve as a heavy paperweight
To play loud music like a radio
quickCheck.explanation: The microcontroller is the brain of your robot, taking in sensor data and commanding motors and lights!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Remember our main big idea: the microcontroller board is the brain that brings robots to life.

quickCheck.question: Why do we take quizzes and challenges at the end of a lesson?
options: To celebrate what we learned and prove our new skills
To erase our memory of what we did
To lose points and start over
quickCheck.explanation: Challenges help review key concepts, celebrate your progress, and earn XP!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Reviews help lock in your new skills and show how much you've learned as a young engineer.

steps.title: Grand Monster Lab Architecture Review
steps.markdownContent: Remember the path: input → code → output. Check power and ground, then make sure your parts are safe for the board.

steps.title: Mini Capstone Inspection Challenge
steps.markdownContent: Complete the board-inspection challenge. Explain one choice, then answer a short review question about a skill you practiced.
